description: Creates a single-use upload link for one file. The link expires after 10 minutes and accepts a file up to 50 MB. page_url opens the upload page. The file name is sent with the conversion so the download is named from it.

filename.description: Original file name, for example model.stl or photo.png. The extension must match the format. The base name is used for the converted file.

from.description: Input format, for example stl or png. Use step for a STEP or STP file. STEP is not an output. Image inputs convert only to image outputs.

language.description: Language the user is chatting in, for example de, pt-BR, or zh-TW. Used for the upload page.

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes. A file over 50 MB is rejected here. The upload itself can be any size up to 50 MB.

name: create_upload_link
title: Create upload link
